sections.Profile:
The "Barnacle Bill" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Ocean, Original Theme, Fantasy
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Roy Parker
- Design: Harry Mabs
sections.Editions: - Barnacle Bill: 2,500 made, released 1948-01-01, model number 8
